items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: he had a lot of 'Kip Porter Stomp' (inaudible) we had got from Fletcher

ctx.x: Fletcher's music. We wasn't going to play what Fletcher was going to play. We would play something else.
When we met him, we just said we ain't going to play his top things, because he had a lot of "Kip Porter Stomp" (inaudible) we had got from Fletcher. Chick would play other things, you know.

When we were at the Savoy, we would play all these things on a Saturday night. These musicians would come up Sunday -- mostly on a Saturday night when they figure the band is going to be really rocking, you know.
